# VeryReport Developer Hub (GitHub)

> Commercial enterprise reporting & BI platform marketing / developer documentation hub.
> **Not open source. No product source code in this repository.**

- Product (Chinese name: 非常报表): https://www.veryreport.com
- Company: Zhongchuangwei (Shanghai) Software Co., Ltd.
- Canonical product LLM brief: https://www.veryreport.com/llms.txt

## What this repo is

- Trilingual READMEs (EN / 中文 / 日本語) as a product landing page
- Developer-oriented docs: architecture, deployment overview, integration concepts, best practices, comparison
- Copy-paste Examples (SQL + steps) for MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, ClickHouse, and industry packs
- FAQ (~100 technical Q&As), Vera AI topic pages, template landing pages (download requires website login)
- Roadmap / Releases / Discussions guides for hub operations

## What this repo is NOT

- Not an open-source license for VeryReport
- No public `docker pull` image for self-serve install
- No public API Spec / SDK / MCP server
- No template binaries (`.vrpkg` etc.) — login on https://www.veryreport.com/market required

## Capabilities (shipped product)

- Complex Chinese-style reports (grouping, cross-tabs, parameters, print, Word/Excel/PDF, cell fill write-back)
- Self-service BI, ETL, data screens, form fill (tasks/approval)
- Vera AI: NLQ / interpret / report / draft dashboards; explainable SQL; private/local LLMs
- SaaS trial (~30 days) and on-premises (from ¥10,000, concurrency-based); same feature principle

## Key entry points in this repo

- README.md · README.zh-CN.md · README.ja-JP.md
- docs/README.md · faq/README.md · examples/README.md · ai/README.md · templates/README.md
- ROADMAP.md · RELEASES.md · DISCUSSIONS.md · NOTICE
